root_cause.text: The DAMON core function `damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp()` trusted the user-controlled `damos_quota_goal->nid` for `node_memcg_{used,free}_bp` metrics and passed it to `NODE_DATA()` without validating that the NUMA node ID was valid, leading to out-of-bounds access.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE and commit message explicitly state that users can set `damos_quota_goal->nid` to an arbitrary value and that DAMON uses it in `NODE-DATA()` without validation, causing out-of-bounds memory access; the patch adds `if (invalid_mem_node(goal->nid))` before the existing logic and returns safe values for invalid node IDs.

agent_logs.root_cause_candidate: The DAMON core function `damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp()` trusted the user-controlled `damos_quota_goal->nid` for `node_memcg_{used,free}_bp` metrics and passed it to `NODE_DATA()` without validating that the NUMA node ID was valid, leading to out-of-bounds access.
agent_logs.evidence_points: The CVE and commit message explicitly state that users can set `damos_quota_goal->nid` to an arbitrary value and that DAMON uses it in `NODE-DATA()` without validation, causing out-of-bounds memory access; the patch adds `if (invalid_mem_node(goal->nid))` before the existing logic and returns safe values for invalid node IDs.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add an invalid-NUMA-node guard in `damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp()` to return safe default used/free basis-point values instead of processing bad node IDs.
intent_record.what: A new early conditional was added at the start of `damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp()` to check `invalid_mem_node(goal->nid)`. If the node is invalid, the function now immediately returns `0` for `DAMOS_QUOTA_NODE_MEMCG_USED_BP` and `10000` for `DAMOS_QUOTA_NODE_MEMCG_FREE_BP` before attempting to look up the memory cgroup.
intent_record.how: This prevents the function from proceeding with calculations or lookups using an invalid NUMA node ID and instead returns a deterministic boundary value representing 0% used or 100% free. At runtime, this avoids operating on invalid node data and ensures callers receive a safe fallback result for invalid nodes.

grouping_result.intent: Add an invalid-NUMA-node guard in `damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp()` to return safe default used/free basis-point values instead of processing bad node IDs.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause by validating/guarding the user-controlled NUMA node ID in damos_get_node_memcg_used_bp() before it can reach NODE_DATA(), preventing out-of-bounds access and returning safe defaults for invalid nodes.

candidates.rationale: This function proceeds using user-controlled goal parameters, and the vulnerable path is specifically driven by the unvalidated goal->nid within this routine. While not the dereference itself, this context line identifies the vulnerable function entry point handling untrusted quota-goal inputs.

vuln_statements.explanation: This is the only exact pre-fix statement provided from the vulnerable routine. It is part of the function that processes user-controlled quota-goal inputs and, before the fix, continued toward using the unvalidated goal->nid for node-specific memcg metrics, enabling the out-of-bounds access via NODE_DATA().
